system.flavor:
Shoulder a stuck door open, barge through a line of people without stopping, knock one person off their feet and take their place in the doorway, or push a heavy chest across a floor in one rush.

Not enough to break a barred door or move a loaded cart.

body.label: Target
body.html: One enemy within melee Weapon Range after your movement.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Move up to 2 units in a straight line. On success, deal 1 weapon Damage and push the target 1 unit.

surges.html: Deal +1 Damage if you moved at least 2 units toward the target.
After a hit, move into the target's vacated space.

rider.title: Combo - Blitz
rider.html: After a hit, you may spend 1 Combo to push a different adjacent enemy 1 unit; compare this Action's Success Die to its Fortitude.
